lines.zh: 我从一片叶子飞到另一片。
lines.en: I flit from one leaf to the next.
I fly along the gaps between the trees.
I know this flower path well.
I skim low over the flowers, slowly.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水拖慢了我。
lines.en: Dew on the grass blades slows me down.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花，我绕了两遍。
lines.en: Dark forest flowers — I've circled them twice.

lines.zh: 林冠漏下的光，一晃一晃。
lines.en: Light through the canopy flickers, on and off.
I know the way to the dark forest's flowers.
The water's colder than yesterday.
Where the wind blows, I drift.
My little tails trail like threads.

lines.zh: 这一排花，我一朵一朵看。
lines.en: I check this row of flowers one by one.
That flower field smells sweet.
I beat my wings softly so the flowers stay still.
The fine lines on my wings look like hair.
A gust pushes me half a foot off course.
Over the flower field, the wind stays gentle.
The scales on my wings are shining.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，夜里也有花开。
lines.en: In the dark forest, flowers open at night too.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花，我找得很快。
lines.en: I find the dark forest's flowers quickly.
The seagrass sways slowly; I sway with it.
This flower is enough to rest on for a while.
On a petal, I fold my wings.
The dark forest nectar tastes bitter.
The nectar in this flower is sweet.
The shadows in the dark forest are long.
I wait for the sun to shift a little.
I should surface for air.

lines.zh: 苔藓被太阳晒暖，趴着正好。
lines.en: The moss is sun-warm — perfect for lying still.
I close my wings and rest a moment.

lines.zh: 别踩那片野花，我刚停过。
lines.en: Do not tread on those wildflowers; I just rested there.

lines.zh: 你每一步，都踩得花枝乱颤。
lines.en: Every step you take shakes the blossoms.

lines.zh: 你比花海里的秆子还高。
lines.en: You're taller than any stalk in the meadow.

lines.zh: 你站在花前面，我落不下。
lines.en: You stand in front of the flower; I cannot land.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往上飞一点。
lines.en: When you reach out, I rise a little higher.
There are grass seeds on your boots.

lines.zh: 你衣角沾着烟灰，我闻得出。
lines.en: There is soot on your sleeve; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你停在花前，我的翅也收住。
lines.en: You stop by the flower, and my wings fold too.
The tail on my wing looks like a hair.
You are taller than the tallest flower.
One corner of my wing is crumpled.
I can no longer fly high; my wings feel heavy.

lines.zh: 我从花上被撞下来，飘着。
lines.en: Knocked off the flower, I drift down.
There is a small tear in my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 我在花海里打转，停不下。
lines.en: I spin over the flower field and cannot stop.
I should hide in that patch of flowers.
My wing membrane is thin as paper.
The pain makes me fly in a crooked line.
A patch of my wing scales is gone.
I land on a leaf to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 花蜜的味道，从那边飘来。
lines.en: The smell of nectar drifts over from there.

lines.zh: 花海的风一停，我就落下。
lines.en: When the meadow wind stops, I settle.

lines.zh: 我翅上的细纹，像条小路。
lines.en: The fine lines on my wings look like a path.
A hint of sweetness, right in your palm.
There is an open flower over there.

lines.zh: 这点甜味就把我引来了。
lines.en: That little sweetness was enough to draw me.
This scent is like a small fish.
There is nectar on your fingertip.
Pollen everywhere; I'll gather it.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的细纹，你看见了吗。
lines.en: Did you see the fine lines on my wings?
You keep to the ground; I keep to the flowers.
The fine scales on my wings are all mussed.
Some of my wing scales have rubbed off.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我的飞行路线。
lines.en: You broke up my flight path.
Do not touch my wings; the scales come off.
You nearly batted me to the ground.
You big creatures are a nuisance.

lines.zh: 翅膀被你撞皱，我得理一理。
lines.en: You creased my wing; I must smooth it.
My fine wing veins mess up at a touch.
My wings are askew; I must straighten them.
The eggs are under the leaf; we keep watch.
We fly at each other above the flower field.
I circle you, drawing a ring in the air.
Circle the creek with me once.
Our wings are the same color.

lines.zh: 你的翅膀花纹，和我一样。
lines.en: Your wing pattern matches mine.
This flower field is enough for the two of us.
We fly side by side, wings in time.
Circle me once, would you?

lines.zh: 花海的细翅，停在你肩上。
lines.en: Fine flower-field wings rest on your shoulder.
I cling to this petal and will not let go.
This one is too heavy; I drag it along.
Carrying it, I fly very low.
I hold it while my wings still beat.
This is too small for me to hold.
This scrap smells sweet.

lines.zh: 这片花瓣，我要挂在网边上。
lines.en: I will hang this petal on my web.
Holding it, I fly crooked.
Nectar has stuck to it.
I will trade a petal for it.
I dip lower, ready to land.
I know the dark forest nectar best.

lines.zh: 它停在那朵花上，不动了。
lines.en: It settled on that flower and stopped.
The dangerous one, I strike first.

lines.zh: 我细弱的嘴咬住就不松。
lines.en: Once my small mouth bites, it does not let go.

lines.zh: 黑森林的这朵花后面，我躲好了。
lines.en: Behind this dark-forest bloom I am hidden.

lines.zh: 那片叶子上，有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something is crawling on that leaf.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花海里，我不起眼。
lines.en: Among flowers and dark trees, I barely show.

lines.zh: 你装成石头，我也看得见。
lines.en: Dress up as a stone and I still see you.
That little fish in the shallows. Don't slip away.

lines.zh: 我翅边那缕细线，像头发。
lines.en: The thin line on my wing edge looks like hair.
Do not leave the flower field.
In the swamp water, you cannot escape.
The flower you brushed is still swaying.

lines.zh: 我的复眼，看得见你的手。
lines.en: My compound eyes see your hands.
One flower in the dark forest is enough.
My wings can keep beating for a long while.

lines.zh: 黑森林里，你的味道太清楚。
lines.en: In the dark forest, your scent is clear.
I circle you, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 花海上，我飞得没有方向。
lines.en: Over the flower sea, I fly without direction.

lines.zh: 花海的蜂抢了我的蜜，你也是。
lines.en: A bee stole my nectar; so did you.
This bite lands on your knuckle.
I dart at the back of your hand.
I still have a little strength left.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一扇，把你扇出三格。
lines.en: One wingbeat and you are three blocks away.
I circle back and ram you again.
My mouthparts can grip a petal.
One flick of my tail, and the pattern flashes.
My eggs are in that patch of flowers.
Reach out again and I bite.
One lap first, to read the water.
I land on a patch of forest light.

lines.zh: 这么深的蓝，我只在花上见过。
lines.en: This deep blue, I have only seen on flowers.
First, a flower to land on and rest.
One twitch of my tails scatters pollen.
My wings are not quite dry yet.

lines.zh: 这片花海，我去年也来过。
lines.en: I came to this flower field last year too.

lines.zh: 我从黑森林边缘飘过来。
lines.en: I drift in from the dark forest's edge.

lines.zh: 黑森林那边有动静，我听见了。
lines.en: Something stirs by the dark forest; I hear it.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花开了，我来了。
lines.en: The dark forest blooms; here I am.
The flame licked the tip of my wing.
Wet wings slow me down.
Dew has plastered my wings shut.
Who threw powder in the water?

lines.zh: 箭尖削掉我一小片翅膜。
lines.en: An arrowhead shaved off a sliver of my wing.
The water shows a purple glow.
I can't draw up any nectar.
When the storm comes, I fly low.
No flowers, no wind, only emptiness.
